title: CostSummary
description: Response shape of GET /api/cost/summary (docs/010 §6, surfaced by docs/014 §4.4). One row aggregates llm_calls within the requested scope.

scope.description: The aggregation window: per-turn (anchored on a message id), per-session (since the JWT's iat), or rolling 24-hour day.

cost_usd.description: USD cost rolled up across all llm_calls in the window.

input_tokens.description: Total input tokens billed across the window.

output_tokens.description: Total output tokens billed across the window.

started_at.description: Lower bound of the aggregation window: the turn's first llm_call timestamp, the JWT iat, or 24h ago. Null when no calls exist in the window yet.

message_id.description: Only set for scope=turn — the anchor user message id the per-turn rollup is keyed on.
